per_ticket_gaps.description: Performed unnecessary Teams cache and temp folder cleanup unrelated to the calendar issue.
Performed unnecessary Office Repair for stale PDL name; could resolve by removing the cached name.
Should not have repaired Outlook on a new laptop; Classic Outlook needs time to sync.
Should have checked OST file size and created a new profile instead of repairing.
Should have guided user to wait for new system to download emails instead of running repair.
Multiple engineers repaired Outlook multiple times for images issue without any diagnosis first.
No troubleshooting performed before Outlook repair; repair used as a default shortcut.
Unclear statement about what was fine in OWA vs Classic Outlook - no specifics provided.
Unclear what 'educated user' means; actual solution not documented in work notes.
Did not mention actual solution; only stated user followed email guide - outcome not captured.
Work notes combined agent/user/L3 comments making root cause unclear and audit trail unusable.
Mentioned 'loading essentials' in New Outlook which does not exist; inaccurate steps recorded.
Notes and screenshots not in chronological order; no explanation provided for screenshots included.
Should know auto-mapping takes up to 24 hours; did not verify or advise user to wait.
Did not recognize mailbox provisioning delay after AD object creation - escalated prematurely.
Did not know correct OWA URL format; escalated instead of advising correct URL.
Claimed emails missing in OWA (impossible if not deleted); validation steps are doubtful.
Did not capture error message when recipient name was not resolvable - no evidence collected.
Did not provide error message when user could not send to PDL - root cause unverifiable.
Did not mention reason for repairing Outlook for shared mailbox addition - no justification captured.
Should have recommended basic spam fixes before escalation; L1 steps were not attempted first.

recommendations.title: Ensure Proper Wait Time
recommendations.body: For new mailboxes or provisioned resources, allow adequate sync time: Auto-mapping up to 24 hours, PDL propagation up to 48 hours. Advise user to wait before troubleshooting.

recommendations.title: Document Clearly
recommendations.body: Work notes must include specific steps taken, exact error messages, explanation of changes made, and confirmation of resolution with user acceptance.

recommendations.title: Capture Evidence Before Repairs
recommendations.body: Always screenshot and log the exact error before applying any fix. Evidence is required for escalation, audit, and root cause analysis.

recommendations.title: Avoid Unnecessary Repairs
recommendations.body: Outlook Repair must not be a default first step. Diagnose root cause first and apply the correct targeted fix.

recommendations.title: Maintain Chronological Notes
recommendations.body: Keep work notes in strict chronological order with timestamps. Separate agent, user, and L3 notes clearly.

recommendations.title: Verify Basic Fixes First
recommendations.body: Follow the escalation ladder. Escalate only when L1 steps are confirmed ineffective.
